priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Do not write issued tokens to application logs
findings.body: Every token passed to `recordIssuedToken` is sent to `console.log`. When production stdout is collected, anyone with log access can retrieve and replay live bearer/session tokens until they expire.

findings.title: [P1] Validate the post-login redirect target
findings.body: Passing an arbitrary absolute or protocol-relative URL to location.assign creates an open redirect after login. An attacker can supply an external return URL and send users from a trusted authentication flow to a phishing site; restrict destinations to approved same-origin paths.
